reviews.summary: Reviewer Lorenzo suggested that the patch's selftest should be a separate follow-up patch and not included in this fix
reviews.raw_body:
Generally, we don't include tests with fixes. So these things have to be a
follow up.

--
Cheers, Lorenzo

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch addresses a concurrency issue in the memfd file system where multiple processes can access and modify the same file position simultaneously, leading to potential data corruption. To resolve this, the patch introduces atomic accesses for f_pos, ensuring that concurrent reads or writes on shared memfds do not overwrite each other's records. The patch also includes self-tests using the kselftest harness to verify the correctness of the changes.
